Container.Name: Pangolin Site
Container.Overview:
Pangolin Site acts as a tunneled gateway for your local network, enabling seamless zero-trust remote access through the Pangolin (https://github.com/fosrl/pangolin) platform. It securely routes traffic to your Unraid services without complex port forwarding or exposure to the public internet.
Chat with us on Discord!
https://pangolin.net/discord

Config.Name: PANGOLIN_ENDPOINT
Config.Description: This is the full URL of the Pangolin instance. Example: https://app.pangolin.net

Config.Name: SITE_ID
Config.Description: This is the unique ID of the Pangolin Site. Example: 31frd0uzbjvp721

Config.Name: SITE_SECRET
Config.Description: This is the secret key of the Pangolin Site. Example: h51mmlknrvrwv8s4r1i210azhumt6isgbpyavxodibx1k2d6

Config.Name: DOCKER_SOCKET
Config.Description: Set the Docker socket container path for container discovery integration.

Config.Name: Docker Socket Path
Config.Description: Mount the Docker socket for container discovery integration.
